headerDisplay: Finds every Big Ass Fan (Haiku / SenseME firmware) on your local network and adds it to HomeKit with its fan, light, occupancy sensor and Whoosh switch.
footerDisplay: Homebridge must be on the same network as the fans and able to send UDP broadcasts (in Docker, use host networking).

fan_count.title: Number of fans
fan_count.description: How many fans to look for. The plugin keeps scanning until it has found this many.

fan_on.title: Fan speed when turned on
fan_on.description: Speed (out of 7) to use when HomeKit turns the fan on.

light_on.title: Light brightness when turned on
light_on.description: Brightness (out of 16) to use when HomeKit turns the light on.
